snippet.title: Dino Mayhem - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Play as legendary dinosaurs to devour enemies, demolish buildings, and wield high-tech weapons in Dino Mayhem. See the destruction you can cause in this Dino Mayhem trailer for the upcoming retro pixel 2D action city-smasher. Play solo or with friends in a zany level-based campaign, competitive PvP modes, and pure destructive fun inspired by '90s arcade games.

Dino Mayhem will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
